newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland Korona trebles NAV, doubles mkt share in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Poland Korona trebles NAV, doubles mkt share in Q1.

text.p: Polish mutual fund company Korona SA trebled its net asset value in this year's first quarter and lifted market share to eight percent from 3.8 percent at the end of last year, the firm said in a statement on Monday.
"The fund's net asset value on December 31, 1996 amounted to 52 million zlotys and at the end of the first quarter...it amounted to 155 million zlotys," the statement said.

Korona is a joint venture between Creditanstalt Securities SA, the Polish broking subsidiary of Austria's Creditanstalt-Bankverein, and Polish state-controlled agricultural bank Bank Gospodarki Zywnosciowej SA (BGZ).
It runs three separate balanced, equity and money-market funds.
